title: Sugar
description: Global supply of raw and refined sugar sourced from certified mills and delivered through structured bulk commodity logistics.
overview:
AFGT supplies raw and refined sugar sourced from certified sugar mills across major producing regions. The company coordinates bulk procurement, logistics, and delivery for institutional buyers including food manufacturers, trading houses, and industrial processors.

Sugar shipments are handled through established export corridors with documented quality specifications, shipment traceability, and internationally recognized certifications.
